question: What action is Parvati instructed to perform using the fire seed-syllable?
premises: The instruction is addressed to Parvati.
The fire seed-syllable is the instrument.
inference: Parvati is instructed to perform the thread-cutting using the fire seed-syllable.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the fire seed-syllable is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O Parvati, one should perform the cutting of the thread using the fire seed-syllable.
